page.overview:
What is Department of Magical Games and Sports?

The Department of Magical Games and Sports was a department of the British Ministry of Magic. It was charged with the regulation of all sport-related events in the wizarding world.

Level Seven of the Ministry of Magic housed the Department of Magical Games and Sports, which was somewhat "untidy-looking" in comparison to the other Ministerial Departments.

The department had a very relaxed ambience and various posters of Quidditch teams tacked lopsidedly on the walls.

The International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy was signed in 1692, and it made each individual Ministry of Magic responsible for the consequences of all magical sports played within their countries.
